acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fungalfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Sporeling, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Dust-Puff Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Knee-high plain brown cap, stubby limbs, no glow, and only a faint movement puff.
Signature mechanic: Stub Step: a bulbous foot plants, the plain brown cap tips, and one faint nonpersistent dust puff marks the opposite side.
battlefieldDuty: Probe approach timing with one short dust puff after each planted step.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network; T2 alone adds faint gill glow; T3 adds its constant spore cloud; T4 adds smaller mushrooms; T5 adds throne and ground network.
Directional gill vanes, cap-edge streamers, pressure-carved stalk channels, aligned spore vectors, and one still air pocket distinguish affinity force from ordinary spore drift.
counterplay: Move under the lifted edge and strike the planted stalk after the puff. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network, so the still pocket exposes its stalk; T2 faint gill glow pauses between gusts; T3 constant spore cloud parts at intake; T4 smaller mushrooms point to the pressure stem; T5 throne and ground network align around the still node.
forbiddenTreatments: Calling ordinary spore drift Wind affinity
identityInvariants: Cap-headed, stalk-bodied silhouette with gills, bulbous limbs, and a wider top than base remains recognizable.
Pale fungal flesh and one strong cap tone contrast with bounded cyan or green gill bioluminescence from T2 onward.
Fungal flesh, spongy cap, mycelium, damp moss, and spore dust remain organic and spatially coherent.
Cap breadth, gill light, spore density, secondary growth, and ground mycelium escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: The knee-high stalk compresses and its unlit cap edge lifts.
